_doc: M3-RND-03: a revenant's tells (RevenantTells, game/vfx/revenant/revenant_tells.gd; docs/kb/tech/revenant_tells.md). still_layer: the visual layer (1-based) a still actor's meshes join (19 is the cutscene key light, 20 UndertowHalfRes). Reflection: the water's SSR uses a flat normal wherever the mirror ray meets the actor's capsule (radius and height from the meshes' AABB, padded by capsule_pad_m; at most max_still_actors at once). Shadow: each shadowed DirectionalLight3D stops casting the actor, and a cancelling pair of spot lights stands in for it on the actor alone: one positive and shadowed (shadow_blur = shadow_blur, sharper than the key's), one negative and unshadowed, both spot_distance_m up the light's direction; the cone covers shadow_reach_m around the actor (its shadow at low sun), widened by cone_margin so the cone's own edge falloff stays outside.
